answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and isolated to the primary region while settlement writes are at daily peak, which matches the prior regional latency degradation more closely than a global code fault. Failover previously restored latency in minutes with a clean traffic shift and without dropping customer writes. The 2-hour-old release and peak load remain plausible contributors, so rollback and add-capacity are not ruled out. Circuit breaking risks shedding writes, which violates the objective; read-replica routing addresses reporting load, not the write path. Verify the failover archive, then shift a guarded slice first because secondary headroom under full settlement peak is unknown and settlement has downstream value risk.
